notes: Clean debugging trajectory. The assistant identified the root cause (missing `self.rank` attribute when `torch.distributed` is unavailable/uninitialized), reproduced the error with a minimal script, applied a targeted one-line fix (`self.rank = 0` as default in the else branch), and verified the fix resolves the AttributeError while preserving existing distributed behavior and the warning message. The change is minimal and correct.

The fix addresses the RuntimeError by falling back to torch.backends.cudnn.flags() context manager, but critically fails to maintain a persistent reference to the context manager object. In CPython, the context manager is garbage-collected when the function returns, triggering __exit__() and reverting the flags. The reproduction script appears to work (no exception) but the actual CUDNN deterministic/benchmark flags are not permanently set. A proper fix needs module-level persistence of the context manager or an alternative approach.
